issues.title: Ingest Lincoln County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $8,489,816 across 21 funds. The largest: General Fund ($3,622,327), Road Fund ($2,275,568), Jail Operations & Maintenance ($996,996). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile Office of Collector (General Fund)
issues.detail: The ordinance appropriates $250,203.18; the application for appropriation (p. 17) requests $255,570.19, split into the categories shown. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
